create_file_handler: create a FileHandler instance with an agent_id, topics list, and output directory for MCAP logging
reset_for_new_file: reset the FileHandler for a new file with a given output file prefix and start timestamp
write_message: write a Safari message to the current MCAP shard with automatic file rotation on size limit
finalize_and_close_file: finalize the current MCAP shard by writing metadata, closing the file, and moving it to the dated output directory
review_file_handler_class: review the FileHandler class for thread-safe MCAP file writing with shard rotation and read-only finalization
